chunks: And it is narrated: “Whoever applies perfume at the beginning of the day while he is fasting will hardly lose his sanity.”

key_terms.بِطِيبٍ: with perfume or a pleasant scent

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about wearing perfume while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith mentions a recommended etiquette for the fasting person: applying perfume early in the day. It presents this as something beneficial for mental composure and well-being during the fast.
